description: Bilingual English-Norwegian parallel corpus from Norwegian Maritime Authority website is a dataset listed in Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology. This dataset has been created within the framework of the European Language Resource Coordination (ELRC) Connecting Europe Facility - Automated Translation (CEF.AT) action SMART 2014/1074). For further information on the project: Contents of website downloaded, aligned and converted into parallel corpus. Coverage: Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology. The publisher named on the listing is Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2017-12-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is European Commission reuse notice. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-cnect.
